summary: Brand Engagement Network filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 disclosing a September 30, 2026 Settlement and Forbearance Agreement with Evora Partners resolving a dispute over a January 2021 consulting contract inherited from predecessor DHC Acquisition Corp. Evora accepts $825,000, including $75,000 of attorneys' fees, versus roughly $1.3 million owed. The company paid $175,000 upfront and will pay the remaining $650,000 in installments through December 2026, guaranteed by BEN Capital Fund I, LLC; Evora will dismiss its September 2, 2026 SDNY breach-of-contract suit. No M&A or capital-structure event; watch liquidity and guarantor support.
